text:
ivy: midnight emergency question: whats your go-to 2am snack when logic is asleep? pizza crust, cereal with coffee, cheese straight from the block, or something wild?

samir: cereal + espresso. weirdly functional. :coffee: :cereal:

joan: cold pizza slice. primal and perfect. :pizza:

kiki: peanut butter + pickles. dont judge until you try it. :zipper_mouth_face:

ivy: @kiki i'm both horrified and curious. anyone actually tried the pb+pickle combo?

samir: been there in college. salty-sweet surprise. 6/10 would repeat.

joan: wow. 6/10 is a full review. adding to my dare list.

skack-bot: Snack poll logged: cereal 1, cold pizza 1, pb+pickles 1 (1987654340).

ivy: plan: late-night snack run tomorrow? trade samples and rank them 1-10. winner gets a sleepless badge. :medal:

kiki: i'm in, will bring the pickles.

samir: i'll bring emergency espresso.

joan: i'll bring an extra pizza crust. informal science.

ivy: perfect. midnight culinary anthropology club is born.
